prerequisite_readonly: Consume naturally accepted existing18 before defining relative recovery. Never restart or replace a missing point automatically.

experiments.purpose: Separate 2DCONV/PF naive composite DTC benefit from unequal hit and completion service timing.
experiments.design: CH,DH,DH matched-service; pipeline latency and throughput explicitly matched, never serial sleep20. Preserve Hash, ownership, queues, input, counters and all unrelated policies.
experiments.cost: Proposed six fresh same-build points; count is a design estimate, no authorization or budget registration.
experiments.required_observation: admit/Tag/ready/gather/scoreboard timestamps; per-bank pipeline throughput; observation-on/off timing equivalence.
experiments.interpretation: Sensitivity of complete designs; does not establish equal physical area or a unique Tag/Data effect.

experiments.purpose: Distinguish L2 locality/replacement, later re-miss, simultaneous same-line requests and independent pre-ready DTC blocking.
inputs: one predeclared strided input, prefer BICG for first audit
experiments.design: CH/DH P0 observer-off/on with identical model semantics. Export queue residence sum/count/histogram, occupancy-cycle integrals, UID+line+generation+sector lineage, PIB-full/NO_FREE_LINE/Tag/notify/gather/retire blocking. Bounded event sampling and explicit kernel boundaries.
experiments.cost: Initial four fresh points for one-input two-design observation equivalence; expansion to PQ/PS requires a separate explicit count.
experiments.required_observation: Observe request creation, accepted L2 lookup, victim/fill, FIFO, dram delay, FRFCFS bank assignment, column issue, data return and scoreboard release.
experiments.interpretation: No change to arbitration, capacity, timing or queues. Same address alone is not a duplicate; count accepted requests once by root/sector.

experiments.purpose: Separate greater DRAM clock/service opportunity from shorter absolute counted timing delays in currentPS.
experiments.design: At1700MHz scale elapsed-time DRAM-cycle timings to preserve850MHz absolute ns, auditing derived timing constraints. Keep core delays such as dram_latency100, geometry, queues and mapping unchanged.
experiments.cost: Up to four new matched-ns cells after existing source-identical P0/PS pairs close; otherwise new baseline counts need approval.
experiments.required_observation: Cycles, accepted L2/DRAM traffic, scheduler residence and service utilization under identical input and source.
experiments.interpretation: Not automatically a pure bandwidth test; transfer, bank-group and turnaround constraints require explicit units.

experiments.purpose: Test the 2DCONV association with conventional per-address merge rejection.
experiments.design: Fix CH Hash/geometry/pipelined latency. Change merge8 to one predeclared larger limit; preserve address entries512. Record occupancy, rejection attempts and actual per-SM blocked-cycle unions.
experiments.cost: One variant plus same-build matched baseline; two fresh points unless exact baseline reuse is independently qualified.
experiments.required_observation: Per-address merge population, downstream requests, request service and completed workload cycles.
experiments.interpretation: Resource-budget sensitivity, not equal-area or pure decoupling proof.

experiments.purpose: Determine whether deeper FIFO and faster DRAM time domain interact after independent effects are known.
experiments.design: FIFO64/256 x DRAM850/1700; P0/PQ/PS are existing three corners. Add only the joint corner for CH/DH on the identical existing binary/config contract.
experiments.cost: Two new cells only if all existing six same-input corners are strict accepted and reusable; no automatic retries.
experiments.required_observation: K interaction from complete matched CH/DH results, traffic and all queue stages, with fixed population identity.
experiments.interpretation: Conditional lowest priority; do not infer necessity from an early5% observation.
